description:
List or search reports (documents) written in Myriade.

Without ``query`` returns the most recently updated reports first; with
``query`` returns the best matches first. Only reports the caller may see
are returned. Read one with myriade_read_report.

database_id.description: UUID of the database whose reports to list. Omit for organisation-level reports (not bound to a database).
database_id.title: Database Id

query.description: Optional search terms (title, description, content); results are ranked by relevance
query.title: Query

name: myriade_list_reports
